author: B

components.title: Whole request
components.what: A $24,000 loan is repaid in equal monthly payments over 4 years at 6.75% APR, compounded monthly (standard amortization). What is the monthly payment, in dollars to the nearest cent? Show brief working, then end with exactly one line of the form FINAL: <answer>.

log.author: B
log.draft:
Standard amortization formula:  
\(M=P\frac{r}{1-(1+r)^{-n}}\)

Using \(P=24000\), monthly rate \(r=0.0675/12=0.005625\), and \(n=4\times12=48\):

\(M=24000\frac{0.005625}{1-(1.005625)^{-48}}=571.930...\)

Check by evaluating the displayed formula with a calculator or spreadsheet PMT function: `=PMT(0.0675/12,48,-24000)`.

FINAL: 571.93
